statements.t: “The recently announced 12-week topline results from our ATTO-1310 Phase 1b trial exceeded our expectations, building on the compelling Week 4 findings and providing further evidence supporting our differentiated target product profile: rapid, deep, and durable itch relief, meaningful skin lesion improvements, the potential for quarterly dosing, and a favorable safety profile.
We have also made significant progress in preparing for our two Phase 2 ATTUNE trials in CPUO and high-itch AD, both of which remain on track to initiate in the first half of 2027.
